title: Season 1
overview: Nick Fury battles a covert Skrull infiltration embedded in world governments.

episodes.title: Resurrection
episodes.overview: Nick Fury returns to Earth after learning of Gravik’s rebellious Skrull cell in Moscow.

episodes.title: Promises
episodes.overview: Fury confronts the fallout of the Moscow bombing and his history with Talos.

episodes.title: Betrayed
episodes.overview: Fury and Talos infiltrate a submarine to stop a Skrull nuclear strike.

episodes.title: Beloved
episodes.overview: Gravik attacks the U.S. President’s motorcade while Fury races to save him.

episodes.title: Harvest
episodes.overview: Fury prepares for the final confrontation and retrieves the Avengers DNA Harvest.

episodes.title: Home
episodes.overview: G’iah battles Gravik with Super-Skrull powers while Fury prevents world war.
